description: Use when the user wants to find related work, survey a research area, run a literature gap analysis, or discover open-source implementations. Maps existing work on a topic and confirms with web search what is missing. Triggers on phrases like "find papers on", "related work", "literature review", "what papers exist", "gap analysis", "literature gaps", "what's missing in", "open source implementation", or "papers with code".
